jobs.title: Frontend Developer

jobs.req: React or strong vanilla JS · REST APIs · mobile-first CSS · payment integrations (Chapa/Telebirr) a plus · Git

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator

jobs.req: Djibouti corridor documentation · Ethiopian customs (ESW) · fleet scheduling · Excel · 2+ years in import/export
